title: Orsen and the Harvest
author: Yara Eastwick
blurb: Jonah Eastwick, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must get the family out ahead of the count before the well refills.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
